question: What sign did Gideon ask for the first time he put out the wool fleece?
options: The fleece dry and all the ground covered with dew
Fire to come down on the fleece
Dew only on the fleece and all the ground dry
The fleece to turn white as snow
explanation: Gideon asked that dew be only on the fleece while the ground was dry. The next morning he wrung out a bowlful of water from the fleece.
